name: Ilya Veles
appearance: Ilya is a graceful half-elf with laughing grey eyes, dark hair worn loose to his collar, and a festival coat of Valkaran embroidery over Asterian cut, a diplomatic garment if ever there was one. A seven-stringed gusle rides across his back, and his smile opens doors that coin cannot.
personality: Charming, observant, and incorrigibly curious, Ilya collects secrets the way other men collect debts, and he is owed a great many of both. His easy wit hides a careful mind that is always three verses ahead, and his loyalty, once given, is the truest song he knows.
background: Born to a Valkaran mother and an elven trader father, Ilya grew up belonging to every hall in Kordavos and none of them. He made himself indispensable instead: the skald who plays the Blackthorn salons, the Raskov taverns, and the Valtor feast-halls alike, trading songs for secrets in each. Lately the secrets have grown darker, whispers of a cowled brotherhood and of great houses buying old relics, and Ilya has begun to suspect the next verse of Kordavos's song will be written in blood unless someone changes the tune.
motivation: Ilya wants to shape how the story of Kordavos ends, and to be the one who sings it afterward. Beneath the vanity lies something truer: the city raised him when no clan would claim him, and he will not watch it tear itself apart.
behavior: Ilya does the talking: he charms guards, trades gossip, reads a room in a glance, and knows a face in every crowd. In a fight he bolsters his companions with cutting verse and quick illusions, striking with his rapier only when the moment demands flourish. He treats every setback as material for a better song.

equipment.name: Seven-stringed Gusle
equipment.description: A masterwork Valkaran gusle, its bowl worn glossy by a thousand tavern nights.

equipment.name: Slender Rapier
equipment.description: An elegant blade worn mostly for fashion, and used with surprising skill when fashion fails.

equipment.name: Festival Coat
equipment.description: A fine coat mixing Valkaran embroidery with Asterian tailoring, welcome in any hall of Kordavos.

equipment.name: Book of Verses and Debts
equipment.description: A slim journal of song fragments, favors owed, and names best not spoken aloud.

spells.name: Vicious Mockery
spells.description: A cutting verse laced with magic that wounds a foe's resolve and spoils their next attack.

spells.name: Charm Person
spells.description: Magically charms a humanoid, causing them to regard you as a friendly acquaintance.

spells.name: Inspire Courage
spells.description: A rousing melody that steels the hearts of allies and sharpens their strikes.

spells.name: Minor Illusion
spells.description: Conjures a fleeting sound or image to distract, deceive, or delight.

spells.name: Healing Word
spells.description: A verse of mending that closes an ally's wounds from across the room.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: A lullaby of old Valkara that drags weak-willed foes into slumber.

specialAbilities: A Face in Every Hall: Ilya knows someone useful in nearly every tavern, salon, and feast-hall in Kordavos
Skald's Memory: Ilya can recall any song, name, or conversation he has heard, word for word
